newsitem.title: USA: Applebee's to buy St. Louis restaurants for $36 million.
newsitem.headline: Applebee's to buy St. Louis restaurants for $36 million.

text.p: Applebee's International Inc. said Monday it agreed to acquire 11 Applebee's restaurants in the St. Louis area from its franchisee, Apple Partners L.P., for about $36.1 million.

The company also said it will acquire several restaurants under development, including two that are expected to open in the first half of 1997. Under the agreement, Applebee's will reimburse Apple Partners for the costs of developing the restaurants.
The 11 St. Louis area restaurants had average sales of about $2.7 million in 1996, it said.
Applebee's International franchises and operates restaurants in 45 states under the trademarks of Applebee's Neighbourhood Grill and Bar and Rio Bravo Cantina.
